description: A tie that A8.1 and the last race both leave standing (both boats DNF there) is broken by the next-to-last race.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A8.1: counted scores best to worst, first difference wins. A8.2: 'they shall be ranked in order of their scores in the last race. Any remaining ties shall be broken by using the tied boats' scores in the next-to-last race and so on until all ties are broken.' A5.2 gives both DNF boats the same score, one more than the boats entered.
working: 4 boats entered, so DNF scores 5. No score is excluded.
R1: A 1, C 2, B 3, D 4. R2: B 1, C 2, A 3, D 4. R3: C 1, D 2; A DNF 5, B DNF 5.
A and B tie on 9. A8.1: A [1, 3, 5], B [1, 3, 5], identical.
A8.2, last race R3: A 5, B 5, still tied. Next-to-last race R2: A 3, B 1. B is ahead.
